name: Caroline LSM
title: Amazing tool to skyrocket one's brand
text:
Poppy AI is a trusted tool recommended by different content creators I've been following for a long time and their journey shows how they also evolved along the way by using Poppy AI which is why I gave it a shot.

During my onboarding call, Mo helped me understand how to use it to its full potential and needless to say, navigating it on my own was nothing compared to the board his built for me. I can see how many possibilities I can do with it now and I appreciate his patience with the questions I had. 

The one thing I wish was different is that the fees were in $CAD too especially when the creators I follow are Canadians, I'm sure a lot more would be interested in this tool. I'm aware that I'll be charged more due to the conversion fees which is the only downside.

name: Will Donovan
title: Initially it seemed daunting… then content started appearing.
text: Initially it seemed daunting to jump in. My biggest concern was these tool seem great until you try and personalize it for your brand and they don’t maintain context. Mo immediately emailed after sign up and offered a quick catch up in my time zone to quickly walkthrough their (pretty much) click and start creating templates to connect options for our marketing content workflows. Super happy and lots of resources to get the most out of the tool.
